subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should unconfigured memory search get a default-on periodic sync fallback, or should the watcher-staleness fix preserve the current opt-in interval default?
rationale: The bug is real at the source level, but the most direct fallback changes existing default runtime behavior and background work, which repository policy treats as a maintainer product/upgrade decision.

options.title: Approve scoped default-on fallback
options.body: Repair the linked PR's dirty scoping, document the `0` opt-out, and accept the 30-minute default as the stability tradeoff.

options.title: Keep interval sync opt-in
options.body: Preserve the `0` default and close or retarget the linked PR to docs/doctor guidance plus watcher recovery only.

options.title: Choose watcher recovery first
options.body: Prioritize watcher liveness/error recovery without changing periodic sync defaults, and revisit default-on fallback only with more live outage proof.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped default-on fallback
recommendation.body: Repair the linked PR's dirty scoping, document the `0` opt-out, and accept the 30-minute default as the stability tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on stale memory search behavior and tests makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the default/fallback decision.
